entities.summary: Nikolai Andreyevich Borodin was a Russian ichthyologist, politician, and journalist. He served as a deputy of the First State Duma of the Russian Empire representing the Ural Oblast, was a member of the Constitutional Democratic Party, and later became a professor at Harvard University.
